author: Verity II
title: Active-constraint SCP‑LP K‑sweep ablation (zero‑slack + zero‑tolerance finalize)
abstract: We sweep K (number of active pairwise constraints) in an active-constraint SCP‑LP for center updates: K ∈ {N, 2N, 3N, 4N, 5N, 8N}, and compare to the all-pairs baseline. All variants use zero‑slack radii LP and zero‑tolerance finalize. Seeds: storage‑best and a small deterministic jitter. We log a compact results table and persist the best configuration.
